author: KEXP
description: Hailing from Tulungagung, Indonesia, atmospheric black metal band Numeron take listeners on a cosmic sonic journey. Live on KEXP at AXEAN Festival, the group delivers a performance of "Blood In My Vein" and more.
title: Numeron performs "Blood In My Vein" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG and AXEAN present Live on KEXP in Bali with Numeron performing at Locca Sea House. Recorded August 27, 2026.

Songs:
Triumph Of Death 00:41
Cosmic Symphony 06:06
The Lost Twin Observer 12:20
Blood In My Vein 18:26
My Eternity 24:22

Agatha Tito Yohansah - Drum
Galih Prayogi - Guitar
Andro Amanusa - Guitar
Fatkurohhim Septianto - Bass
Luthfi Anshori - Vocal

Live on KEXP in Bali is a partnership with AXEAN. Recorded at Locca Sea House, in Bali, Indonesia

Host: Diana Ratsamee
Audio Recording, Mix & Mastering:  Matt Ogaz
Guest Audio Engineer: Febri Antonia
Monitor Engineer: Agus Kardjo 
Audio Production Assistants: Anggi Artyana, Jesking, Gus Apri, Hari Jaya, Eka Sudida

Cameras: Jim Beckmann, Carlos Cruz, Luke Knecht & Ettie Wahl
Editor: Jim Beckmann

Fixer: Natha Raharja
Camera & Lighting Equipment: Joyfilm Bali
Lighting Control Programer: Matthew Cole
Lighting Guard: Riyan Grevan
Camera Guard: ⁠Soebandi
Driver Camera & Lighting: Andang

AXEAN team:  Py Fungjai, Satria
